failure: FullFightCases.emit propagated a Windows FileSystemException while appending the primary encounter JSONL, causing a server ticking-entity crash.
readerQualification: A concurrent audit used System.IO.File.ReadLines on the active primary log. Its default share mode can deny writes and is the likely trigger; the exception itself does not identify the owning reader handle. This is a test-harness I/O interruption, not a native boss defeat or a proved Sable movement hang.
preservedMeasurements: Native shield durability1 and phase0 were observed. Accepted native damage observations remain observations; there is no complete final inventory/outcome accounting.
mitigation: All owned live tactic readers now use FileShare.ReadWrite|Delete. The parent assigned separate non-throwing queued test-log writes to another agent. No production boss behavior or source survival-server files changed.
